measures.name: Breast Cancer Screening
measures.definition: Share of eligible women who had a recent mammogram.

measures.name: Colorectal Cancer Screening
measures.definition: Share of eligible members up to date on colorectal screening.

measures.name: Controlling Blood Pressure
measures.definition: Share of members with hypertension whose blood pressure is controlled.

measures.name: Diabetes Eye Exam
measures.definition: Share of members with diabetes who had an eye exam.

measures.name: Diabetes Blood Sugar Control
measures.definition: Share of members with diabetes whose blood sugar is controlled.

measures.name: Statin Therapy for Cardiovascular Disease
measures.definition: Share of members with heart disease who are on a statin.

measures.name: Follow-up After Emergency Visit
measures.definition: Share of ER visits followed by outpatient follow-up.

measures.name: Plan All-Cause Readmissions
measures.definition: Ratio of actual to expected hospital readmissions (lower is better).

measures.name: Getting Needed Care
measures.definition: Survey: members report getting care and specialist visits when needed.

measures.name: Getting Appointments Quickly
measures.definition: Survey: members report timely appointments.

measures.name: Customer Service
measures.definition: Survey: members rate the plan's customer service.

measures.name: Care Coordination
measures.definition: Survey: members report their care is well coordinated.

measures.name: Rating of Health Plan
measures.definition: Survey: overall member rating of the plan.

measures.name: Improving or Maintaining Physical Health
measures.definition: Share of members whose physical health stayed the same or improved.

measures.name: Improving or Maintaining Mental Health
measures.definition: Share of members whose mental health stayed the same or improved.

measures.name: Reducing the Risk of Falling
measures.definition: Share of members who discussed and acted on fall risk.

measures.name: Call Center: Interpreter Availability
measures.definition: Share of test calls where an interpreter was available.

measures.name: Complaints About the Plan
measures.definition: Complaints per 1,000 members (lower is better).

measures.name: Members Choosing to Leave the Plan
measures.definition: Voluntary disenrollment rate (lower is better).

measures.name: Timely Decisions About Appeals
measures.definition: Share of appeals decided on time.

measures.name: Medication Adherence: Diabetes
measures.definition: Share of members taking diabetes medicine as prescribed.

measures.name: Medication Adherence: Hypertension
measures.definition: Share of members taking blood pressure medicine as prescribed.

measures.name: Medication Adherence: Cholesterol
measures.definition: Share of members taking statins as prescribed.

measures.name: Medication Therapy Management Review
measures.definition: Share of eligible members who got a comprehensive medication review.

checks.name: Duplicate contract-measure rows
checks.detail: Each contract should have one score per measure.

checks.name: Missing measure scores
checks.detail: 3.3% of contract-measure cells have no score (new plans or too little data are normal).

checks.name: Measures without cut points
checks.detail: Every measure needs cut points for the rating year.

checks.name: Cut points in the right order
checks.detail: Higher-is-better cut points should rise with stars; lower-is-better should fall.

checks.name: Negative scores
checks.detail: Measure scores should not be negative.

checks.name: Contracts without a published overall rating
checks.detail: New or low-enrollment contracts may not receive an overall rating.

checks.name: Star published but score missing
checks.detail: A published star without a raw score cannot be rebuilt.

checks.name: Rebuilt measure stars vs CMS stars
